data.title: 厄普西隆 · 琴房午后的指尖合奏教学
data.description: 午后静谧高雅的私人琴房内，厄普西隆在黑色三角钢琴前挨坐身旁，纤细双手轻叠指尖悉心指导，眼神既骄傲又藏着甜蜜的心跳。
data.location: elegant sunlit private piano music room with grand piano
data.action: sitting side by side on grand piano bench, hands gently guiding viewer's fingers on piano keys, leaning close, proud yet sweetly blushing expression
data.lighting: soft golden window light casting gentle highlights on piano keys and sheer blouse
data.mood: refined musical intimacy, proud mentorship, sweet romantic heartbeat
data.promptProse: In a sunlit private music parlor, light blue-haired elf Epsilon sits closely on the grand piano bench, tenderly guiding hands over the ivory keys with a proud yet blushing smile.
data.animaCaption: Leaning close on the piano bench to guide the viewer's fingers, she smiles with proud affection.
